claim_boundary: One end-of-season 2021-22 global ranking workbook across six gender-weapon sheets. Identity keys are normalized spelling-country pairs, not verified unique people, and event points are descriptive records rather than training exposure or causal outcomes.
rights_boundary: Kaggle reports an unknown dataset license, and the workbook appears derived from FIE ranking pages. Raw names, the workbook, row-level Parquet files, and trained artifacts stay local. Only code, hashes, aggregate counts, and integrity results belong in a public release.
